image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of an African crocodile (Nile crocodile) resting on a sandy bank. The image focuses primarily on the head and upper torso, showing the textured, armored skin, closed eye, and interlocking teeth along the jawline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct point (V-shape), distinguishing it from the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure is broad and consistent with Crocodylus niloticus morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple large, conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the lower jaw even though the mouth is closed, demonstrating the characteristic interlocking arrangement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the eye is positioned dorsally, it appears closed or heavily squinted in this specific frame. The vertical slit pupil and nictitating membrane are not clearly visible due to the angle and lighting, making strict verification impossible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are clearly located at the very anterior tip of the snout, consistent with the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows heavy armor plating and extends out of frame, implying an elongated structure typical of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal surface exhibits distinct, raised bony scutes arranged in clear longitudinal rows behind the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of grey and earthy browns, and the texture is visibly rough and granular, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crocodile is lying on its belly; the ventral surface is completely occluded by the ground and the animal's own body weight.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are tucked under the body or outside the frame; no feet or digits are visible for verification.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this cropped composition focusing on the head.
